history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration remind all entities to expedite the clearance of overdue travel expense reports in Umoja to ensure the accurate and timely recording of travel-related expenditure.
history.administration_response: The recommendation was implemented. The Human Resources Services Division, in collaboration with the Travel and Transportation Section and the Payroll and Accounts Payable Section of the Department of Operational Support, has developed guidance informing entities that it is mandatory for all travel requests to have corresponding expense reports. Furthermore, the Administration has identified all open travel requests that do not have corresponding expense reports and has shared this information with all entities so that they can review the open requests and proceed with closing them by submitting the corresponding expense reports.
history.board_assessment: Given that the new guidance has been issued, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
